premise_join: single ASCIIspace between whole provided evidence sentences in selected order
native_ranking: one query percase, all N unit IDs returned exactlyonce, no outside corpus
lexical_ranking: Jaccard of lowercase Unicode regex \w+ sets, descending score then original unit index
numerical_literal_checks: AUDIT_ONLY_no forecast modification; regex may retain suffixes inside adjacent currency notation; not semantic numeric correctness
unsupported_checks: fail admission whole batch; no replacements
primary: strict E>0.5 then N>0.5 else false
argmax: diagnostic only, native logit first maximum
